title: Authelia Auth Event Failure Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=authelia:auth fail_count=*
| stats sum(fail_count) as total_value, avg(fail_count) as avg_value by username
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks user values by total and average failure count across Authelia auth event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `fail_count` values for each Authelia auth event event and review total and average failure count by user.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total failure count.
grandmaExplanation: It steadily which user shows the biggest failure count numbers in your Authelia auth event data.
